desc: The Live Wild edition rifle was designed in partnership with Remi Warren. Leaning on Remi’s years of hunting experience, we built a rifle that is perfect for a wide range of hunting adventures. With accuracy and dependability at the forefront, Remi wanted his special edition rifle to be built on the historic Mark V action. From there he wanted to load this rifle up with features including, an adjustable TriggerTech trigger, spiral fluted barrel and bolt, skeletonized bolt knob, radial Accubrake ST, and hand-painted stock. Starting at 5.6 lbs, the Live Wild rifle won’t weigh you down while trekking deep into the backcountry.
